### God’s Goodness in the Vineyard
Author: Erik Raymond
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/erik-raymond/gods-goodness-in-the-vineyard/
Passage: Isaiah 5:1-7
Points:
- God demonstrates his deep love and gracious care through his diligent cultivation of his vineyard.
- Despite receiving every divine advantage, Israel rebelled and produced worthless fruit rather than justice and righteousness.
- God's intrinsic goodness demands judgment against wickedness, as overlooking sin would compromise his holy character.
- Jesus fulfills the vineyard imagery by coming as the true vine who redeems his people and empowers them to bear good fruit.
